name: decoy_single
_comment: Wave 5, asteroid decoy capture: land at Kit Decoy Port, accept the J0 target mission (target on Kit Decoy Marker, 250 px east, on screen), take off and stay put, then fire ONE JamM Decoy missile (Seeker 0x0002, JamVuln 0) every 2 s for 90 s while one asteroid drifts around. analysis/decoy_track.mjs gives each missile's path and its distance to the rock. Pilot w5_decoy1.
